posts.cooked:
Yeah, over in the thread discussing it, FV + Ra certainly seemed like the most frequent guess, so it interests me that so many people are surprised by it now.

 

You know what surprises me?  Bunker's outfit.  Legacy, Tachyon, and AZ all have a similar look going on, with more blue and fewer neutral tones.  Wraith doesn't really join in on that, instead opting for an outfit close to her Rook City get-up with a larger mask (SPOILERS: the mask is too little too late, and her secret identity gets out in the near future) - but she does add the same vertical lines on her torso which Legacy is now sporting, presumably presaging the grey "side panels" in the Tactics uniforms.  And then... Bunker is in this bright red suit with a glowing Arc Reactor, looking sinister as anything.  Let's be real, here - that's the suit Blade wears on his flip side, right?  I like to imagine that when he came to join up as "Luminary," Tyler Vance was totally against letting him do anything, and then he broke out the suit with a giant (angrily glowing) red bow on it, and then Bunker was all in favor.  Ah, well - at least he's not wearing Akash'Bhuta this time.
